text:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: inference-v2 @2.3.4 — staged rollout to 20% over 30m. ID: rl-2026-0319-77. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.dev/rl-2026-0319-77
sam: Copy. I'll monitor latency + errors. ping me if EU starts acting up.
alex: QA smoke passed on my local samples. good to go from dx.
maria: ran the prompt sanity set — no obvious regressions on sample outputs.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift: us-east-1 -> 5% -> 10% done. eu-west-1 -> 5% -> 10% done.
cheng: seeing EU 5xx rate jump: 0.2% -> 1.8% over 3m, p50 latency +60ms. :grimacing:
sam: Hold rollout at current distribution (10%). Pause further shifts.
alex: Agreed. Options: rollback EU to 2.3.3, pin EU to stable, or keep paused and investigate. My vote: pin EU to 2.3.3 so customer traffic unaffected.
maria: I'll run targeted evals against the failing prompt set and dump request samples.
deploy-bot: Suggested command to pin region:```bash
redwoodctl region pin --region eu-west-1 --service inference-v2 --version 2.3.3
```Please confirm.
cheng: Executing pin now.
cheng: Pin command completed — eu-west-1 pinned to 2.3.3. Traffic reverted to stable for EU. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Action logged: region_pin by cheng (rl-2026-0319-77).
sam: Good. Keep global rollout paused. Ops: collect traces for errors, sample request IDs, and stack traces.
triage-bot: Created ticket INF-4321: "EU 10% spike during staged rollout" assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1. Link: https://issues.redwood.dev/INF-4321
alex: Note for release notes: include pin + rollback action and change window (30m paused). Add guidance for re-run cadence.
maria: I'll update the release notes draft and attach evaluation artifacts to INF-4321.
deploy-bot: Current rollout status: PAUSED. Distribution snapshot: us-east-1: 10% -> v2.3.4, eu-west-1: 0% -> v2.3.4 (pinned to 2.3.3).
sam: Plan: hold for 30m while eng-runtime triages. If no regressions in US within 30m, resume with 5% increments and extended observation windows (10m each). If errors reproduce, we'll rollback globally.
alex: :thumbsup: keep notify on any fresh spikes.
maria: uploading sample requests to the ticket now.
cheng: I pushed a temporary canary tweak (increased sampling of error logs) and set alert throttling to avoid noise.
sam: thanks. I'll call a quick sync after 30m and decide stop/go.
alex: standing by.
